title: Pharma Test Apparatebau AG
description:
Pharma Test is an internationally leading manufacturer and household name for the development a
nd production of high-value test devices and systems. They offer a complete product range from 
manual, physical testing instruments to fully automated, analytical test systems to analyze the
active chemical composition of a dosage form as well as its release rate.

We will upload 46gb corporate data soon. Employee personal information (passports and so on), f
